Overview

A complete, comfortable Umrah for pilgrims who want to stay close to the Haram. You fly direct from Mumbai, stay in 5-star hotels within walking distance of Masjid al-Haram and Masjid an-Nabawi, and get guided Ziyarat in both holy cities. Our team in Saudi Arabia looks after you from arrival to departure.

Tour highlights

  • Direct flights from Mumbai to Jeddah / Madinah
  • 5-star hotels near the Haram in Makkah and Madinah
  • Guided Umrah with an experienced Muallim
  • Ziyarat of Makkah: Jabal al-Noor, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah
  • Ziyarat of Madinah: Masjid Quba, Uhud, Masjid al-Qiblatayn
  • Umrah visa and Saudi insurance included

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Depart Mumbai, arrive Jeddah, transfer to Makkah

Wear Ihram before the Miqat. Fly from Mumbai to Jeddah. Our team meets you and transfers you by coach to your hotel in Makkah. After resting, perform your Umrah with our Muallim.

  • Dinner
Day 2 Makkah: rest and prayers

A day to rest after Umrah and pray in Masjid al-Haram. Our group leader helps first-time pilgrims find their way around the Haram.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 3 Makkah Ziyarat

Guided Ziyarat of Jabal al-Noor (Cave of Hira), Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat and Jabal al-Rahmah. Afternoon free for Ibadah.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 4–7 Makkah: days of Ibadah

Free days for prayers, Tawaf and extra Umrah if you wish. Optional visit to Masjid Aisha (Taneem) for Ihram. Our team is on call 24/7.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 8 Makkah: Tawaf al-Wada and travel to Madinah

Perform the farewell Tawaf. Check out and travel to Madinah by Haramain high-speed train or coach (about 2.5–5 hours). Check in near Masjid an-Nabawi.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 9 Madinah: prayers at Masjid an-Nabawi

Pray in the Prophet's Mosque and visit Riyadh ul-Jannah (as per Nusuk permit availability). Offer Salaam at the Rawdah.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 10 Madinah Ziyarat

Guided Ziyarat of Masjid Quba, Masjid al-Qiblatayn, Mount Uhud and the Martyrs of Uhud, the Seven Mosques area and date farms.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 11–14 Madinah: days of Ibadah

Free days for prayers in Masjid an-Nabawi and personal Ibadah. Time for shopping for dates and gifts near the Haram.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
  • Dinner
Day 15 Depart for Mumbai

Check out and transfer to Madinah (or Jeddah) airport for your direct flight to Mumbai. Ma'a salama!

  • Breakfast

Inclusions & exclusions

What's included

  • Return economy flights Mumbai–Jeddah/Madinah
  • Umrah visa with Saudi medical insurance
  • 5-star hotels near the Haram (about 8 nights Makkah, 6 nights Madinah)
  • Breakfast, lunch and dinner (Indian buffet)
  • All transfers by AC coach; Makkah–Madinah by train or coach
  • Guided Ziyarat in Makkah and Madinah

Not included

  • Qurbani / Dam if required
  • Personal expenses, laundry and phone calls
  • Extra Umrah transport not in the plan
  • Any increase in taxes or visa fees after booking

Good to know

Best time to go: All year outside Hajj season. November to February is cooler; Ramadan is spiritually special but busiest and costliest.
  • Prices start from ₹1,10,000 per person and change with travel dates, hotel choice and flight fares.
  • The day-by-day plan is a guide. Sightseeing order can change with flight times, weather and local conditions.
  • Every package is fully customisable: add nights, upgrade hotels or travel privately.
  • Need a visa, forex or travel insurance? We arrange all of it under one roof.

Frequently asked questions

How far is the hotel from the Haram?

On the Deluxe package, hotels are within walking distance of the Haram in both cities. We confirm the exact hotel name before you pay the balance.

Can women travel without a mahram?

Saudi rules now allow women to perform Umrah without a mahram. We recommend travelling in our group, and we will guide you on the latest rules.

Is the number of days fixed?

No. We also run 10-day and 21-day groups and can change the split between Makkah and Madinah. Ask us for the next group dates.
